notes: Zone 14 = Perungudi. Tables use old ward numbers 181-191 (profile text maps old 183 -> new 181, old 186 -> new 184). Map legends (pp. 740, 748) use yet another numbering (e.g. relief R1 'ST Thomas Primary School' = ward 168 on map vs 185 in table); map wards not used.

Zonal office address/phone not given. Zonal Officer listed twice (admin and engineering tables), kept once. AEE Mechanical cell prints '9445190484,9445190490, 9094046132,9094046132' - duplicate 9094046132 kept once. Designations 'ExecutiveEngineer–I/II' etc. given word spacing.
Transport AE 9445026115 is the 'Assistant Engineer contact No.' for JCB/Bobcat/lorries (p. 749); designation context added in parentheses.

Heavy-rain water-stagnation table (pp. 729-732; text says 86 spots, table has 88 rows) has motor/pump details, so it is recorded under inundation_streets with an extra 'reason' field (reason for inundation). Rows 37 (Giri Street) and 38 (Kasturibai street) have no motor details. Row 20/21 motor cells read '4 / HP' and '50 / HP' as printed. No mild/moderate tables; no sewer blocks in this zone ('There is no sewer Blocks').

Relief centres: text says 12 centres with total capacity 3250, but the 12 printed capacities sum to 10500. Column order is Drinking water, Toilets, Cooking facilities: all centres YES/YES/NO. Each row has its own 4 contacts (SI/AE/ARO/AE by responsibility); 'responsibility' added to each contact. Row 5 streets printed 'enkatesapuram' (likely Venkatesapuram) - kept as printed.

Relief-centre map legend (p. 740) also lists Athiparasakthi Kalyana Mandabam, Indhumathi Kalyana Mandapam, St.Antony, Govt Hr Sec School and St.Thomas Panchayat Union Middle School (R7, R12, R14-R16) not in the table; not added.

Evacuation table (pp. 745-746, NEM Dec 2015, 19100 people evacuated): second row has no ward printed (streets are in Puzhuthivakkam, probably 186) - ward null; the streets cell may span rows 1-2 - split at the row line (row 1 ends 'Mathiazhagan Street'). Ward 187 row has no year. Wards 190 and 191 share relief centre 'Panchayat Union Middle School, Jalladampet' (merged cell). 'area' not given.

Water entered houses (pp. 742-744): text says 10 locations; table has 14 rows (two rows numbered 11). Each entry is a whole table row (comma lists not split, because several items are not standalone street names, e.g. '2nd main road'). Row 5 and the second row 11 have no ward printed (null) - by content probably 183 and 190.

NDRF: table lists only ward 189 IIT Colony Community Hall; map p. 748 legend lists 6 NDRF points (Zonal Office-14 Puzhuthivakkam, AGS Colony Indoor Stadium, School Road Unit Office, Division Office ECR Main Road, Holy Prince Matri.Hr.Sec School, Sri Neelambal Mahal) and 19 boat points - not added (map numbering).
Parks: split on commas from one cell per ward; 70 entries vs 75 stated in text. Some entries are roads, kept as printed. 'location' not given (null).
Sewage pumping stations: only 'Pumping stations available at Dn 184', no list. No TNSCB tenements, no subway, no battery-powered lighting, no hospital/UPHC/police/fire lists in this appendix.
The 'Less than 2.5 m streets/lanes that cannot be accessed by vehicles' table (pp. 750-751) is not in the schema and continues past the end of zone_14.txt (p. 752+ not included in the text file).
